questions.title: Share of children who die before age five in Brazil
questions.hint: Vaccines, clean water, and treatment for diarrheal disease all reach children first.
questions.explanation: It fell to 2.5% in 2005, from 19.2% in 1955.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Life expectancy at birth in India
questions.hint: Life expectancy reflects deaths at every age, so a change among the young moves it most.
questions.explanation: It rose to 70.2 years in 2020, from 45.6 years in 1960.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Median age of the population in the United States
questions.hint: Half the population is older than the median. It moves slowly and depends mostly on past births.
questions.explanation: It rose to 37 years in 2020, from 29 years in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Average number of children per woman in South Korea
questions.hint: Fertility tends to respond to education, urban living, contraception, and the cost of raising children.
questions.explanation: It fell to 0.8 in 2022, from 2.7 in 1980. South Korea’s fertility rate is now among the lowest in the world.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in the world
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It went from 1.7% in 1950 to a high of 2.1% in 1965, then ended at 0.9% in 2020.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects
